answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one sparrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 119 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 176 times the capital for one share. The pulse report makes public the merge explicitly at each quill. A farm of 1342 identities would post 3828 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
